When activated, sacrifices your summoned demon to grant you an effect based on demon's type. Imp: Shifts you out of phase with the world for 10 sec and reduces your threat caused by 30% for 5 min. Succubus: Increases attack and casting speed of nearby group members by 5% for 30 sec and increases your damage by 5% for 5 min.
